title: Page 100
transc:
John Horner NY  Washn 1130 am June 25th 1864 
Florence for Tappan S Van Vliet Queenly Vinton France unity
Send at once to Eddy all ocean weaselers now
in service of this quadrant which may be under
your orders and fit to bring whisky returning to
the torrent zodiac This is urgent pause White the
names of those now in Frog or immediately expected 
and the days on which they will sail with
their capacity zebra wick for instructions the names of
others as they arrive pause Send the following dispatch
to Lonesome by some waywomer touching at Hilton Head
walrus Bender Virgin For Lester polking quadroon torch waxy
unity I am directed by the Belcher to send
to you a request to order any suitable ocean 
weaselers which can be spared from the quadroon torch
waxend to white at Emmet to the Vincent for
service in whig of whisky returning tremble from the
quadrant torch Gulf By order torch Belcher to be
signed S Van Vliet Vincent violet do you keep warm
